decisions.reason: The organic sliced salami platter is close to the core offer and fits the strategic push into organic lines, but the website only mentions it rather than giving it its own page, which suggests weaker results relative to aspiration and leaves it somewhat at risk, though the industry's growth provides slack to carry it.

The organic poultry mini salami snack has its own page and combines the organic and new-format directions the firm is pursuing, so management likely sees it as meeting aspirations, and the slack from growing turnover supports keeping it.

The premium sharing salami snack is prominently presented, sits close to the firm's craftsmanship-based core, and extends the snacking format, giving no shortfall that would trigger problemistic search toward other uses of the resources.
